title: Make a quote from the record
summary: Create → Quote: date, currency, doctor, branch and the quote's services.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Create
steps.details: Everything that can be created for this patient: clinical, financial and scheduling.

steps.title: Quote
steps.details: Opens the quote with the patient filled in.

steps.title: Add item
steps.details: Adds a line to the quote; it can't be saved without at least one.

steps.title: Service
steps.details: Choose the service or product; the unit price comes from the catalog.

steps.title: Quantity
steps.details: The line total is recalculated with the quantity.

steps.title: Save the quote
steps.details: Add the services and save. Once accepted, it creates the treatment plan.
